# Nelson Marlborough Institute of Technology (NMIT)

> > Nelson Marlborough Institute of Technology offers tertiary education programs across IT, nursing, business, arts & design, and adventure tourism in New Zealand.

NMIT delivers undergraduate and postgraduate courses spanning information technology, healthcare education, creative arts, accounting, and outdoor recreation. Programs emphasize practical skills, evidence-based practice, and professional development across diverse disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Information Technology & Cloud Computing
- Nursing Education & Healthcare Practice
- Evidence-Based Practice
- Business & Accounting
- Arts & Design Studio Practice
- Mobile Application Development
- Digital Photography
- Adventure Tourism & Outdoor Recreation
- Professional Development
- Systems Architecture
- Strategic IT Leadership
- Community Health
- Creative Practice
- Technical Skills Development
- Clinical Practice Assessment

## Information Technology Programs

- [IT8530 Advanced Mobile Application Solutions](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/it8530-advanced-mobile-application-solutions): Advanced mobile app development course covering multimedia integration
- [IT8519 Systems Architecture and Technology Integration](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/it8519-systems-architecture-and-technology-integration): Enterprise systems architecture and technology integration course
- [IT8512 Cloud Computing and ICT Infrastructure](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/it8512-cloud-computing-and-ict-infrastructure): Postgraduate cloud computing and ICT infrastructure analysis course
- [IT9503 Advanced Information Management and IT Solutions](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/it9503-advanced-information-management-and-it-solutions): Strategic IT decision-making and organizational leadership course
- [IT9504 Leadership in IT and Digital Organisations](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/it9504-leadership-in-it-and-digital-organisations): Postgraduate IT leadership and digital transformation strategy course

## Nursing & Healthcare Education

- [Special Topic: Nursing Practice Assessment 1](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/special-topic-nursing-practice-assessment-1): Level 6 nursing practice assessment course with supervised clinical work
- [Evidence Based Nursing 3](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/evidence-based-nursing-3): Bachelor of Nursing course focusing on evidence-based healthcare practice
- [Nursing Practice 3: Community Health](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/nursing-practice-3-community-health): Community health nursing practice with clinical reasoning focus
- [Knowledge for Practice 3](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/knowledge-for-practice-3): Patient-centered nursing care across the lifespan (BN705003)
- [Evidence Based Nursing 2](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/evidence-based-nursing-2): Evidence-based nursing education for professional development

## Arts & Design Studio Courses

- [AAD647 Studio 1](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/aad647-studio-1): Arts & design studio course for creative project development
- [AAD646 Object Design 2](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/aad646-object-design-2): Advanced object design processes and skills development
- [AAD648 Studio 2](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/aad648-studio-2): Self-directed art & design studio creative practice course
- [AAD549 Digital Photography](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/aad549-digital-photography): Digital photography technical and creative skills development
- [AAD644 Critical Studies 1](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/aad644-critical-studies-1): Critical studies developing research skills and professional identity

## Business & Accounting Programs

- [ACCY8102 Advanced Financial Accounting](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/accy8102-advanced-financial-accounting): Postgraduate advanced financial accounting and reporting course
- [ACCY8108 Business Law and the Business Environment](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/accy8108-business-law-and-the-business-environment): NZ business law, commercial transactions, and company regulation course

## Sport & Adventure Tourism

- [ATG540A Advanced Rafting](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/atg540a-advanced-rafting): Advanced rafting technical skills and water safety for adventure tourism
- [SRE608B Skill Acquisition and Performance Psychology](https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/course-instances/sre608b-skill-acquisition-and-performance-psychology): Sport coaching psychology and skill acquisition pedagogy course
